lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase sach driRaae man tan saachai raataa he ||11||
lines.translation: He Himself forgives, and implants the Truth. The mind and body are then attuned to the True Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan mailaa vich jot apaaraa ||
lines.translation: Within the polluted mind and body is the Light of the Infinite Lord.
One who understands the Guru's Teachings, contemplates this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar sadaa man niramal rasanaa sev sukhadaataa he ||12||
lines.translation: Conquering egotism, the mind becomes immaculate forever; with his tongue, he serves the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੜ ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਹਟ ਬਾਜਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaR kaaiaa a(n)dar bahu hat baajaaraa ||
lines.translation: In the fortress of the body there are many shops and bazaars;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich naam hai at apaaraa ||
lines.translation: within them is the Naam, the Name of the utterly infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa dar sohai haumai maar pachhaataa he ||13||
lines.translation: In His Court, one is embellished forever with the Word of the Guru's Shabad; he conquers egotism and realizes the Lord. ||13||
The jewel is priceless, inaccessible and infinite.
How can the poor wretch estimate its worth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋਲਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabade tol tolaae a(n)tar sabad pachhaataa he ||14||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is weighed, and so the Shabad is realized deep within. ||14||
The great volumes of the Simritees and the Shaastras
Only extend the extension of attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਪੜਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh paRahi sabad na boojhahi guramukh viralai jaataa he ||15||
lines.translation: The fools read them, but do not understand the Word of the Shabad. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, understand. ||15||
The Creator Himself acts, and causes all to act.
Through the True Word of His Bani, Truth is implanted deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੬॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai vadiaaee jug jug eko jaataa he ||16||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, one is blessed with glorious greatness, and throughout the ages, the One Lord is known. ||16||9||
Maaroo, Third Mehl:
Serve the True Creator Lord.
The Word of the Shabad is the Destroyer of pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar keemat nahee paaee aape agam athaahaa he ||1||
lines.translation: He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be evaluated. He Himself is inaccessible and immeasurable. ||1||
The True Lord Himself makes Truth pervasive.
He attaches some humble beings to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saacho sevahi saach kamaavahi naame sach samaahaa he ||2||
lines.translation: They serve the True Lord and practice Truth; through the Name, they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||2||
The Primal Lord unites His devotees in His Union.
He attaches them to true devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਇਸੁ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saachee baanee sadaa gun gaavai is janamai kaa laahaa he ||3||
lines.translation: One who sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord, through the True Word of His Bani, earns the profit of this life. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh vanaj karahi par aap pachhaanahi ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh trades, and understands his own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekas bin ko avar na jaanahi ||
lines.translation: He knows no other than the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahu sache vanajaare poo(n)jee naam visaahaa he ||4||
lines.translation: True is the banker, and True are His traders, who buy the merchandise of the Naam. ||4||
He Himself fashions and creates the Universe.
He inspires a few to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevahi se jan saache kaate jam kaa phaahaa he ||5||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true. He snaps the noose of death from around their necks. ||5||
He destroys, creates, embellishes and fashions all beings,
and attaches them to duality, attachment and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਜੇਵੜਾ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh phirahi sadaa a(n)dh kamaavahi jam kaa jevaRaa gal phaahaa he ||6||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander around forever, acting blindly. Death has strung his noose around their necks. ||6||
He Himself forgives, and enjoins us to serve the Guru.
Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam comes to dwell within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਾਚਾ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam dhiaae saachaa is jag mahi naamo laahaa he ||7||
lines.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the True Lord, and earn the profit of the Naam in this world. ||7||
He Himself is True, and True is His Name.
The Gurmukh bestows it, and enshrines it within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਕਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jin man vasiaa se jan sohahi tin sir chookaa kaahaa he ||8||
lines.translation: Noble and exalted are those, within whose mind the Lord abides. Their heads are free of strife. ||8||
He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be appraised.
By Guru's Grace, He dwells within the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਤਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sabad saalaahee gunadaataa lekhaa koi na ma(n)gai taahaa he ||9||
lines.translation: No one calls that person to account, who praises the Word of the Shabad, the Giver of virtue. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahamaa bisan rudr tis kee sevaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva serve Him.
Even they cannot find the limits of the unseen, unknowable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹਾ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau nadar karahi too apanee guramukh alakh lakhaahaa he ||10||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed by Your Glance of Grace, become Gurmukh, and comprehend the incomprehensible. ||10||
